name: p1_stroke_isles_imaging
outcome_definition: Expert-annotated diffusion lesion volume >= 21 mL (the DAWN trial thrombectomy core-volume cutoff), derived from the ISLES 2022 expert lesion mask. The model observes only DWI/ADC/FLAIR and never the mask. This is a CHARACTERISATION of an already-identified acute infarct, not detection of whether a stroke is present -- every ISLES 2022 case is a stroke patient, so the release contains no negative class for a detection task. Measured core-volume distribution over 250 cases: median 6.7 mL, mean 23.4 mL, max 482 mL; 65/250 (26%) exceed the 21 mL cutoff. DEFUSE-3's 70 mL cutoff was rejected as it leaves only 22 positives.
